name: CEAT Ltd

ledger.quote: We expect total CAPEX for the financial year to be around Rs. 1,000 crores as mentioned earlier.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Normal capex outflow for the current year remained in line with the INR1,000 crores estimate.
ledger.evidence: Reported cash flows and capex figures for FY26 confirmed total outlays met the guidance.

ledger.quote: This will continue over the next three to four quarters.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Management transitioned direct customer relationships over 3 to 4 quarters as promised.
ledger.evidence: Overall transition is happening as per plan, about 60% of the customers have transited to CEAT by end of Q1, and we expect to complete the customer transition by end of Q2.

ledger.quote: and this will take five to six quarters to complete.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Upstream equipment setup is progressing over the 5 to 6 quarters timeframe.
ledger.evidence: The transition from buying semi-finished goods from Michelin to buying our own raw material will take some more time. It will be completed by end of quarter 4 of FY '27.

ledger.quote: We hope to bring the inventory level to a normal level in Q3.
ledger.speaker: Kumar Subbiah
ledger.verdict: Inventory levels were normalized in Q3 as guided by management.
ledger.evidence: Reported operating performance and working capital metrics in Q3 FY26 confirm normalized operations.

ledger.quote: This marks a significant step in advancing our aim towards achieving ~60% clean energy share in operations by FY '27.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Clean energy share target of ~60% by FY27 is still pending as FY27 is ongoing.

ledger.quote: We expect this capacity addition to be progressively completed by the second half of financial year 2028.
ledger.speaker: Kumar Subbiah
ledger.verdict: Additional capacity of 35 lakh tires by second half of FY28 remains pending.

ledger.quote: So at least for '27, should we continue to expect at least high single-digit growth to sustain?
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: High single-digit growth target through FY27 remains pending as the year is ongoing.

ledger.quote: I think so. We can expect high single-digit growth in replacement through FY '27.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: High single-digit growth in replacement through FY27 remains pending.

ledger.quote: In the next 3 to 4 years, we expect to bridge this gap over a period of this time. And our ambition is to definitely go for market leadership in this segment.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.target: Bridge gap and achieve market leadership
ledger.verdict: Bridging the gap and achieving market leadership within 3 to 4 years is pending.

ledger.quote: By end of FY '27, the entire value chain may be under our control.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Controlling the entire value chain by the end of FY27 remains pending.
ledger.evidence: Hence, FY '28 is the first full year when we'll have control of the entire value chain.

ledger.quote: By end of first half, the sales side, which is the customer interface should be in our control.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.by_when: end of first half of FY27
ledger.verdict: Target to take over 90% of customer interface by September 2026 is on track for Q2.

ledger.quote: We need to take another at least 5% price hike through the month of May and June, which we are planning.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Management implemented price hikes of about 5% through May and June as promised.
ledger.evidence: about 7% to 8% in replacement, about 3% to 4% in OE and about 4% to 5% in IB has already been taken.

ledger.quote: In the near term, we expect replacement demand for MHCV to be in high single digit, arising out of increased economic activity, positive seasonality and an aging fleet.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Replacement demand for MHCV was reported in mid-single digits as expected.
ledger.evidence: In the near term, we expect replacement demand for MHCV to be mid-single digit.

ledger.quote: Overall demand outlook is expected to moderate out, therefore, but broadly may remain supportive.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Demand outlook moderated as expected while remaining supportive with strong Q1 revenue growth.
ledger.evidence: Standalone revenue grew 18.2% year-on-year in Q1 FY27, confirming supportive demand.

ledger.quote: As we enter FY '27, while input cost inflation presents a near-term headwind, structural demand drivers remain in place, providing the resilience and momentum needed to navigate this phase and sustain future growth.
ledger.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
ledger.verdict: Sustaining future growth through FY27 remains pending as the financial year progresses.

open.quote: We expect this capacity addition to be progressively implemented over by FY '31 in stages.
open.speaker: Kumar Subbiah
open.target: Implement new capacity progressively by FY31

open.quote: As shared earlier, we intend to incur capex in the range of INR1,300 crores to INR1,400 crores during FY '27, and we would like to stick to the above plans as of now.
open.speaker: Kumar Subbiah

open.quote: The market saliency is about 13%, and it will grow to 30-40% in the next 5 years.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee

open.quote: We expect to complete the customer transition by end of Q2.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
open.target: Complete customer transition by Q2 end

open.quote: It will be completed by end of quarter 4 of FY '27.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
open.target: Complete raw material value chain transition by Q4 FY27

open.quote: In the near term, we expect replacement demand for MHCV to be mid-single digit.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee

open.quote: In 2-wheeler growth is expected to be in high single digits, where consumption levels have surpassed already pre-COVID levels.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee

open.quote: Passenger tyre demand is expected to be mid-single digit.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee

open.quote: We expect demand for MHCV to grow in mid or high single digit, while OEM 2-wheeler and passenger car tyre demand is expected to grow in double digits.
open.speaker: Arnab Banerjee
open.target: OEM demand growth single to double digits

read: Management maintains a reliable track record of honoring capex guidance and executing operational integration plans on schedule. However, severe commodity inflation has temporarily compressed operating margins.
questions: When do you expect the Camso business to turn EBITDA positive given the ongoing startup costs?
How will the new INR1,205 crores 2-wheeler capacity capex impact future leverage ratios?
Will further price hikes fully offset the elevated natural rubber prices in Q2?
bull: Standalone revenue grew 18.2% year-on-year in Q1 FY27, backed by robust replacement volumes.
Customer interface transition for Camso is on track, with 60% completed by the end of Q1.
Strong cash flow generation with FY26 operating cash flow reaching INR1,786 crores.
bear: Consolidated Q1 FY27 PAT dropped sharply to INR4 crores due to forex losses and startup costs.
Gross margins contracted by 575 basis points sequentially due to surging raw material costs.
Consolidated debt increased by INR232 crores over Q4 to reach INR3,243 crores.
